messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the **Canadian federal holidays that create long‑weekends in 2023** (including the holiday itself and the adjacent weekend days).  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, it’s observed on the nearest weekday – that day is still part of the long‑weekend.)

| Holiday | Observed Date | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|---------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Mon Jan 2 (observed) | Sat Dec 31 – Mon Jan 2 |
| Family Day (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) | Mon Feb 20 | Sat Feb 18 – Mon Feb 20 |
| Good Friday | Fri Apr 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| Victoria Day | Mon May 22 | Sat May 20 – Mon May 22 |
| Canada Day | Sat Jul 1 | Sat Jul 1 – Mon Jul 3 |
| Labour Day | Mon Sep 4 | Sat Sep 2 – Mon Sep 4 |
| Thanksgiving | Mon Oct 9 | Sat Oct 7 – Mon Oct 9 |
| Remembrance Day | Mon Nov 10 (observed) | Sat Nov 8 – Mon Nov 10 |
| Christmas | Mon Dec 25 | Sat Dec 23 – Mon Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> • **Boxing Day (Dec 26)** is a federal holiday but falls on a Tuesday, so it does *not* create a long‑weekend.  
> • Some provinces observe additional holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador) that can also create long‑weekends locally.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app!
